label: OKO Editor
description: Modify OKO Operational Centre records via the hub API: reclassify the Skolwin incident as animals, mark its task done, and plant a false Komarowo human-movement incident.

steps.label: Fetch API help
steps.detail: Call action=help to discover available commands and syntax

steps.label: Reclassify Skolwin
steps.detail: Update incydenty record to MOVE04 (animals) — was MOVE03 (vehicle+people)

steps.label: Complete Skolwin task
steps.detail: Mark zadania record done=YES with content 'bobry' to close the Skolwin investigation

steps.label: Plant Komarowo incident
steps.detail: Update an existing incydenty entry to MOVE01 with Komarowo city to redirect operator attention

steps.label: Verify and get flag
steps.detail: Call action=done to verify all changes and receive the completion flag
